manual_review.finding: Native Uint8Array byteLength checked against remaining4MiB before decoding; Content-Length advisory early refusal and actual stream count. Single chunk may already be allocated by transport.
Fatal streaming TextDecoder preserves split code points/BOM-compatible text; final decode refuses truncated sequences and no unbounded response.text fallback.

One native15s signal shared across fetch and body; abort checked before dispatch/read, after awaits, final decode and cache admission. Pending rejection observed; late fetch response disposed without reading. Cooperative timer, not an absolute hard deadline during a blocked event loop.
One finally disposal; failure cancel rejection observed without waiting; one release attempt. getReader failure cannot dispose a reader it never acquired. Late response uses separately owned reader.

JSON parses before new entry admission; invalid hit eviction requires object identity. Concurrent malformed completion has no cache write or deletion. Nonfinite/negative/expired cache ages force fetch; successful response shapes/tool suffix unchanged.
HTTP>=400 checked before read; source-scoped sanitized stable errors, source limits and native redirect:error retained; fetch dispatched once with no internal retry.
